headline: 147 active wildfires are burning uncontained in the US today. The most serious is the 0494 Akawa Butte Fire in OR, threatening 4,812 structures.

active_threats.name: 0494 Akawa Butte
active_threats.narrative: The 0494 Akawa Butte Fire in Jefferson County, OR has burned 27,433 acres and is 10% contained. NIFC's incident team reports **4,812 structures threatened**. 1,398 personnel are assigned. Forecast winds will be locally gusty (up to 28 mph, sustained near 11) with humidity as low as 25%. This is a sustained, terrain-channeled wind regime — the setup our WindNinja terrain downscaling is built to resolve. Forecast wind direction (NW, blowing toward the SE) favors pushing the fire toward Crooked River Ranch CDP, 9 miles away.

wind.windninja_applicability: HIGH  - core use case; downscale the sustained flow

emerging_conditions.narrative: A fire-weather pattern is developing over FL: Miami city, Port St. Lucie city, Cape Coral city, Fort Lauderdale city, and Pembroke Pines city and 27 other communities sit under NIFC's Significant Fire Potential outlook (days 1,2). USGS fire-danger models put the local large-fire/spread probability as high as 14% in spots. No fire has been reported yet, but the combination of dry fuels and elevated fire weather is exactly the kind that produces a fast-moving run if an ignition occurs.
